scope: synthetic validation, PCA and instance selection diagnostics; no functional motif claim
pca_rule: One Discovery PCA128 basis per condition, first24/64/128 components shared; fixed PCA seed; KMeans seed alone varied. OH has separate Discovery PCA24. No whitening or feature rescaling.
instance_rule: Within each assigned cluster, apply fixed distance quantile before choosing closest window per promoter; CORE50 includes distances <= within-cluster median. Thresholds fitted only on Discovery and same cluster membership as unfiltered pair.
discovery_only_diagnostics: Save fitted labels/distances and instance overlap with planted truth AFTER fit lock. No truth enters PCA, clustering, distance gates, instance extraction or PWM.

probe.negative_rule: no overlap with planted 12bp core; deterministic sampling
probe.training: Discovery exact-core labels, StandardScaler + balanced LogisticRegression(C=1,max_iter=1000), fixed seed
probe.evaluation: new Test positive sequences only, score all70 windows; top1 exact/within2bp localization; no detection/FPR or functional motif claim
probe.test_encoding: performed only after all unsupervised fits locked
probe.role: supervised diagnostic, never counted as unsupervised discovery

evaluation.family_selection: evaluation-only best full-width reference match; reference-assisted not absolute discovery precision

test_policy: all protocols and fits locked before evaluation; no configuration chosen or refit using Test. Any later method change requires a new Test seed version.
statistics: Average three algorithm runs inside each data seed first; five data seeds are main independent replicate units. Report per-seed deltas, ranges, algorithm success fractions, no treating 15 runs as15 biological replicates. Stress only two data seeds is descriptive.
real_data_gate: Only consider real pilot after reproducible synthetic recovery, stress checks and traditional baseline; absent STREME or unresolved failure means real fitting deferred, not an overall research stop.
